title: Octavia Court missed reserve deposits and later withdrew more than HUD approved

beats.text: One month of payroll appeared twice in Octavia Court’s accounts.

visual.sub: A duplicate payroll entry and late deposits appeared in the same housing audit

beats.text: The 2016 audit also identified $7,614 in late reserve deposits.

visual.kicker: A duplicate payroll entry and late deposits appeared in the same housing audit

beats.text: The missing deposits were made, and the property set up automatic transfers.
In the following two years, the accounts understated net loss.

visual.kicker: The accounts understated net loss in the next two years

beats.text: The adjustments were approximately $12,000 and $15,000 in successive years.
The 2019 follow-up said financial reporting controls had improved.

visual.kicker: The accounts understated net loss in the next two years

beats.text: A later withdrawal exceeded the amount approved by federal housing officials.

visual.kicker: A later reserve withdrawal exceeded the approved amount

beats.text: Separately, the project had not followed the required procurement process for its audit.

visual.kicker: A later reserve withdrawal exceeded the approved amount

beats.text: Octavia Court funded the excess amount in early 2021.

visual.kicker: The project funded the difference and procured audit services

beats.text: The organization also completed the audit procurement process in late 2020.
Every source is linked in the case file below.
